notes: Usage is counted by Ervo's server now: chats per day and research per month (research is when Ervo searches the web or looks something up). Ervo Stats shows what's left, and a friendly note with a See plans button appears at the limit
Everyday chats run on a faster model; research, shopping, plans and photos keep the deeper one
Passwords: sign in with email and password, sign up with a confirmed password, and reset it from an email link that opens Ervo. Three wrong tries and Ervo points you to Forgot password
Keep me logged in (on by default) and Unlock with fingerprint or face, in Settings. Password fields work with Samsung Pass, Google and iCloud Keychain
The company name Ervo is reserved
Businesses: a company is its name plus its location, so two shops with the same name in different cities both fit. The owner gives a first and last name
My Businesses in Settings: switch between your companies, add another, join one with an ID, verify yours with your work email and website, or delete one (type its name)
Each business keeps its own chats, Psyche, team and Ideas
Ervo for Business starts by learning the company: what it does, customers, products, hours, policies, tools, team
Hold your own message for Copy, Send again or Edit
Ervo turns down harmful or illegal requests in one calm line and never shares another company's information
Connected Apps is its own page, out of Ervo Stats; Settings lost the Greeting and Weather rows
highlights: Ervo Stats shows your chats and research left, counted by Ervo
A Plans page explains Free, Plus and Pro
